editorial:
Imagine a cozy countryside setting where a group of kids and their ponies are trying to save a brand new pony hotel. You get a warm, nostalgic vibe right from the start as you meet Dick and his friends. They are eager to get guests through the door, so they decide to head into the city of Lübeck to hand out brochures. It feels like a classic childhood adventure where everything is simple and hopeful, but there is a funny catch. One of the characters, Dalli, decides to spice up the advertisements with some wild lies, which sets up a lot of hilarious tension for the rest of the story.

You will love how the movie captures the bond between the children and their horses. The acting is sweet and natural, and while the pace is slow by today's standards, it is perfect for a relaxing afternoon. The best part is seeing the chaos unfold when the guests actually show up expecting things that aren't there. If you want a clean, heartwarming story, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the beautiful scenery, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with the family.
endingExplained: After the chaos of the misleading brochures, the kids have to deal with the guests who arrived expecting a luxury resort. Eventually, the truth comes out about Dalli's embellishments. However, the guests end up loving the honest, rustic charm of the pony hotel anyway. The movie wraps up with the business becoming a success because people prefer the real experience over the fake promises. Everyone learns a lesson about honesty, and the hotel stays open.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horses, old-school family adventures, and sweet stories about friendship.
